1. This Act may be cited As the Tunku Abdul Rahman
Foundation Fund Act, 1966, and shall apply throughout the
Federation.

2. In this Act—
"Minister" means the Minister of Education.

PART II
FUND

3. (1) There is hereby established a Fund to be known as
the Tunku Abdul Rahman Foundation Fund (hereinafter
in this Act referred to as the "Fund").

(2) The Fund shall vest in and be managed by a Board
of Trustees (hereinafter in| this Act referred to as the
"Board") which shall be a body corporate with perpetual
succession and a common seal with the power to sue and
be sued, to hold property mbpvable or immovable, to make
contracts and subject as
assign, surrender, mortgage,| lease or otherwise dispose of
movable or immovable property vested in the Board upon
such terms as it may think| fit.

PART III
THE BOARD

4. The Board shall have power at its discretion to accept

any grants, donations, endowments, gifts, or bequests made
to or in favour of the Fund.

5. (1) The Board shall consist of the following members
viz.—
(a) the Chairman, who shall be appointed by the Yang
di-Pertuan Agong;
(b) a representative of the Ministry of Education;
(c) a representative of the Treasury; and
(d) six other members to|be appointed by the Minister.

(2) The Chairman and the members of the Board referred
to in paragraph (d) of subsection (1) shall be appointed for
a period of three years and are eligible for re-appointment.

(3) The Chairman shall preside at all meetings of the
Board.

(4) The Board shall meet at such places and times as the
Chairman may appoint and lat any meeting of the Board
five members shall form a qhorum.

(5) The Chairman shall have a casting vote.

(6) Subject to the provisions of this Act the Board shall
have power to determine its own procedure.

6. A member of the Board shall be disqualified from holding
office as such member if h

(a) becomes a bankrupt
(b) is sentenced to a term of imprisonment; or

(c) commits any breach|of trust or any dereliction of
his duty as such member which in the opinion of
the appointing authority warrants his removal.

7. (1) The Minister may at any time remove from office any
member of the Board appointed under paragraph (d) of
subsection (1) of section 5 of this Act and appoint another
in his place.

(2) Without prejudice to |the power of removal under
subsection (1) of this section, the Minister may remove
from office any such member of the Board who by reason
of ill-health or prolonged absence from the Federation is-in
the opinion of the Minister rendered incapable of properly
performing his duties as a member of the Board.

OBJECTS

8. (1) All expenses incidental to the management of the
Fund shall be defrayed from the monies of the Fund in
priority to any other payments.

TUNKU ABDUL RAHMAN FOUNDATION FUND     407

(2) The balance of the Fund after defraying the expenses
referred to in subsection (1) of this section shall subject to
the provisions of this Act be  tilised for the purpose of
providing or awarding such number of studentships, scholar-
ships, study grants or study loans or any other awards as
the Board may from time to time determine to be provided
or awarded to persons as hereinafter mentioned to enable
such persons to pursue such course or courses of education
as the Board may think proper.

(3) The provisions of subsection (2) shall apply to any
citizen of the Federation who by! virtue of his circumstances
or other reasons require in the opinion of the Board to be
provided with or assisted by A studentship, scholarship,
study grant or study loan or any other award under this Act.

9, (1) Every recipient of a studentship, scholarship, study
grant, study loan or any other award provided or awarded
under this Act shall become and during his tenure thereof
shall remain a student at the place of education approved by
the Board and shall pursue his studies thereat to the satis-
faction of the Board.

(2) If any recipient of any award made under this Act
fails to satisfy the provisions of section 8 or commits a
breach of any of the conditions laid down by the Board
or in any way whatsoever misconducts himself he may
thereupon be deprived of such} award.

10. (1) The provisions of this Alct shall be supplementary to
and not in derogation of any other written law relating to
the provisions of studentships,| scholarships, study grants,
study loans or any other awards in force in any part of the
Federation.

(2) If in the opinion of the Board at any time that
circumstances render any award under this Act inadvisable
or if there is in any year no candidate entitled in the. opinion
of the Board to any award under this Act then no such
award shall be made for that year and the money which
otherwise would have been appropriated to such award may
be dealt with as hereinafter provided in this Act.

11. The Board may cease to provide, maintain or assist any
recipient of an award under this Act who contravenes or
fails to comply with the terms or conditions imposed by
the Board in accordance with|this Act or if it appears to
the Board that a further pursuance of his studies is not

12. Before making any award under this Act the Board
may impose such conditions as it deems necessary.

13. The assets of the Fund nay be invested by the Board in
investments for the time being authorised by law for the
investment of trust funds:

Provided that the Board shall not make any investment
in securities issued or registeted or other properties situated
outside the Federation except with the approval in writing
of the Minister of Finance.

14. (1) The accounts of the| Fund shall be audited by an
auditor appointed by the Board with the approval of the
Minister of Finance.

(2) As soon as may be after the end of each calendar
year the Board shall submit to the Minister an audited
account of the revenues and expenditure of the Fund for
that year together with a statement of assets and liabilities
thereof; and the Minister shalll cause the account and state-
ment together with a copy of any observations of the
auditor thereon to be laid bellore each House of Parliament.

15, (1) A common seal of the Board shall be in the custody
of the Chairman and shall not be affixed to any instrument
except in the presence of |the Chairman or any other
member of the Board authorised by the Chairman.

(2) Any instrument bearing the seal of the Board so
affixed and attested shall be deemed to have been made by
the Board.

16. The Board shall have power to appoint a Secretary to
the Board and such other officers and servants as may be
necessary for carrying out the functions of the Board.

TUNKU ABDUL RAHMAN] FOUNDATION FUND     409

17. The Board may by instrument in writing under the
common seal of the Board delegate to any person or body
such of its duties as may be ngcessary to be performed in
or outside the Federation; provided that any such person or
body shall have no control over the Fund and shall act in
all respects in accordance with the direction of the Board.

18. No member of the Board shall be liable for any loss
arising from or contingent upon any investment made unless
such loss has been occasioned by his wilful negligence fraud
or dishonesty; and no member of the Board agent or person
acting under the authority of the Board shall be personally
liable to any action or proceeding for or in respect of any
act matter or thing done or omitted to be done in good
faith and in the proper exercise of any of the rights or
powers of the Board or members thereof.

19, (1) The Board may from tine to time with the approval
of the Minister make rules for |the proper carrying out of
any of the provisions of this Act.

(2) In particular and without|prejudice to the generality
of the foregoing powers such ryles—

(a) may prescribe the awards, the conditions to be
observed and the qualifications to be possessed
by the candidates;

(b) may provide for the payment of salaries and
allowances and conditions of service of the officers
and servants of the

(c) may provide for the establishment and management
of a superannuation pr provident fund scheme
for its officers and servants.

20. (1) If at any time the monies|or other assets of the Fund
are in the opinion of the Board insufficient to meet the
expenses of the Fund and other payments the Chairman of
re Board shall forthwith make a report of that fact to the

inister.

(2) If on receipt of such report the Minister considers that
an appeal for grants donations endowments or gifts should
be made he shall forthwith direct the Board to make such
appeals and the Board shall accordingly comply with such

irection.

(3) If after the expiration of six calendar months from
the date any appeal is made /under subsection (2) no
adequate grants donations or endowments are received
by the Board the Minister shall] direct that the Fund be
